text:
alex: kicking off blue/green cut for /api/v1/generate in 10m. change window 30m. routing config updated to allow 30% -> 70% staged shift.
maya: ack. patch rolled to deploy pipeline, pinned v2.3.1 for green, old v2.3.0 stays pinned on blue.
deploy-bot: deploy started: pipeline/redwood/generate-service v2.3.1 -> green
sam: quick checklist: healthchecks pass on green? logs look clean from smoke tests?
lina: smoke ok on green. memory and p95 look comparable in staging -> ready for canary.
matt_oncall: i'll watch p99 latency, error-rate, and error budget burn. alerting set to page at +2% infra errors or 1% increase in 5m.
alex: plan: route 10% traffic to green immediately, hold 10m; if stable -> 30% hold 15m; then 70% -> 90% ramp and finalize. rollback thresholds: >1% user errors or >5% latency regression p95.
maya: release notes: https://confluence.redwood/notes/generate-v2.3.1
maya: note — model tokenizer tweak means cache warmup may spike first ~200 requests.
router-bot: router config applied: new route 'generate:green' created. current split -> green:10%, blue:90%
sam: seeing initial 10% shift metrics: error-rate 0.12% (baseline 0.10%), p95 +30ms -> within guardrails.
lina: also primed KV cache on green pools, requests/sec warming from 20 -> 180.
matt_oncall: monitoring: no paging signals. keeping eyes on tail latency as warmup completes.
alex: after 10m hold, bump to 30% now.
router-bot: traffic split updated -> green:30%, blue:70%
maya: note pinned release tag in router to avoid accidental further routing changes until finalization.
sam: 30% hold: metrics look steady. minor auth transient logged in a handful of requests, tracing id attached: trace-7a9f
lina: investigating trace-7a9f — appears flakey downstream auth cache, not related to model. mitigation in progress.
matt_oncall: auth transient caused ~0.08% spike for 3m, under rollback threshold. continue.
alex: proceed to 70% ramp in 5m if no new issues.
deploy-bot: scheduled ramp -> green:70% at 5m mark
maya: heads-up: change window midpoint — we're at 18m elapsed. if everything ok, we finalize and unpin blue.
sam: pre-final checks: can we keep blue pinned for 1 hour post-cutover for quick rollback? ops policy allows pin extension on request.
maya: extending pin for +1h. documented in release notes and oncall runbook.
router-bot: traffic split updated -> green:70%, blue:30%
lina: post-ramp metrics: p95 stable, error-rate back to baseline. cache warmed across green nodes.
alex: finalizing now. route finalization will make green primary and mark blue for drain.
router-bot: finalization started: green:95%, blue:5% -> then drain
matt_oncall: if we see >1% user errors during drain, call rollback.
alex: drain in progress. keep monitoring. congrats team :tada:
maya: quick postmortem note — tracked the auth transient and added follow-up ticket: #ENG-2154
sam: thanks. I'll keep the debug traces available for 2h in case we need rapid rollback.
deploy-bot: deploy complete: v2.3.1 -> primary. blue nodes scheduled for graceful termination in 40m.
lina: leaving pin as extended until +1h per maya. will unpin after validation window.
alex: closing thread when blue unpin done. good job everyone.
